description: 电商问数评测集 v1（标注口径：columns 用 meta.column_info.id 全名；metrics 用 metric_info.name；values 用 ES 已索引的真实取值）

cases.query: 华北地区2025年第一季度的GMV是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华北' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025

cases.query: 查询各地区的销售额排行
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dr.region_name AS region_name, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id GROUP BY dr.region_name ORDER BY sales DESC

cases.query: 黄金会员的平均订单金额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(fo.order_amount) AS aov FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE dc.member_level = '黄金'

cases.query: 苹果品牌2025年的总销量是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dp.brand = '苹果' AND dd.year = 2025
